title: v2.1.0 - Frontier Model Generation Alignment (Grok 4.7 & DeepSeek-V4.1)
release_notes:
### ⚡ Frontier Model Generation Alignment

- **xAI Grok 4.7 Upgraded**: Updated xAI's flagship track to Grok 4.7 (released September 2026, 500K context, Low-to-XHigh adjustable reasoning effort, Cursor & Grok Build native terminal agent integration).
- **DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash (1017) Upgraded**: Updated DeepSeek's active frontier to the October 2026 V4.1 generation (Causal Encoder-Decoder CED architecture, 1M context, native multimodal understanding, wish-driven project coding with DeepSeek Harness).
- **Open-Weights Milestone Preservation**: Maintained DeepSeek-R1 (January 2025 landmark open-weights MIT reasoning model) and Grok 3 (Colossus 100K GPU) in historical lineage trees.
- **Agent Engine Alignment**: DeepSeek Coder & Agent engine updated to `🧠 DeepSeek-V4.1 / V4-Pro & R1`, Grok Agent engine updated to `🧠 Grok 4.7 / Grok 4`.
